title: Withanolides from Physalis minima as potential anti-inflammatory agents: From isolation to in vitro and in vivo validation.
authors: Wu, Jiangping; He, Shihan; Yang, Zhu; Zhao, Jianping; Yang, Yiping; Xu, Qiangbao; Feng, Juan; Lv, Qiuyue; Zou, Zhongmei; Han, Jun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物来源醉茄内酯的抗炎活性及机制，涉及TLR4/MD2复合物分子对接与MD模拟，但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Ten withanolides (1-10) were isolated from Physalis minima L., a medicinal and edible plant. Among them, five (1-5) are previously undescribed. Their chemical structures were established through comprehensive spectroscopic and spectrometric analyses. In vitro bioassays revealed that compounds 2-5 and 8 significantly inhibited nitric oxide production in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-stimulated murine RAW 264.7 cells, exhibiting anti-inflammatory effects with IC(50) values ranging from 4.29 to 25.54 muM. Compound 2, which was identified as phyminiolide B and was the most abundant and potent one, potently reduced inflammatory cytokines release and downregulated COX-2 and iNOS expression. Mechanistically, it inhibited the activation of the NF-kappaB and MAPK pathways by blocking the phosphorylation of IKKalpha/beta, IkappaBalpha, ERK, JNK, and p38. Furthermore, molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation revealed that phyminiolide B exhibited strong binding affinity for the TLR4/MD2 complex, with a calculated binding energy of -9.0 kcal/mol. Additionally, in vivo experiments confirmed that phyminiolide B markedly alleviated LPS-induced acute lung injury in animal models, underscoring its therapeutic potential for inflammatory diseases. The findings provided valuable insights into the structural diversity and anti-inflammatory mechanisms of withanolides from P. minima.
abstract_zh: 从药用兼食用植物苦蘵（Physalis minima L.）中分离得到10个醉茄内酯类化合物（1-10），其中5个（1-5）为先前未描述的新化合物。通过综合光谱和质谱分析确定了它们的化学结构。体外生物测定显示，化合物2-5和8显著抑制脂多糖（LPS）刺激的小鼠RAW 264.7细胞中一氧化氮的产生，表现出抗炎活性，IC(50)值范围为4.29至25.54 μM。化合物2被鉴定为phyminiolide B，是含量最丰富且活性最强的化合物，能有效减少炎症细胞因子的释放，并下调COX-2和iNOS的表达。机制上，它通过阻断IKKα/β、IκBα、ERK、JNK和p38的磷酸化来抑制NF-κB和MAPK通路的激活。此外，分子对接和分子动力学模拟显示，phyminiolide B对TLR4/MD2复合物表现出强结合亲和力，计算结合能为-9.0 kcal/mol。体内实验进一步证实，phyminiolide B显著缓解了动物模型中LPS诱导的急性肺损伤，凸显了其在炎症性疾病中的治疗潜力。这些发现为苦蘵中醉茄内酯类化合物的结构多样性和抗炎机制提供了有价值的见解。
